resources.string: Experimental config editor — not device-validated

Only existing, recognised fields are editable. Values are raw game settings, not verified quality tiers or safe ranges. Games may ignore or reset them; no FPS gain, unlock, or anti-cheat safety is guaranteed. Keep the game closed while editing.
